overview_description.description: Humanloop develops an AI platform designed to support enterprises in building and maintaining applications powered by large language models. The platform provides tools for prompt management, evaluation, and observability, enabling teams to test, monitor, and improve AI system performance. Humanloop supports collaboration between engineers, product teams, and domain experts to refine AI outputs and ensure reliability. Its tools are used to manage workflows around AI development, helping organizations deploy and optimize AI features with structured evaluation processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Humanloop is an AI platform that helps enterprises evaluate, manage, and monitor large language model applications.

product.name: Humanloop Platform
product.description: An enterprise platform for developing, evaluating, and shipping large language model (LLM) powered applications with prompt management, evaluation, and observability.

product.name: Prompt Editor and Management
product.description: Tools for collaborative prompt development, version control, and deployment management for LLM applications.

product.name: LLM Evaluations
product.description: Automated and human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows integrated with CI/CD to assess and ensure AI system performance.

product.name: AI Observability
product.description: Monitoring, alerting, tracing, and logging tools to track AI system behavior and capture user feedback in production.

product.name: Enterprise Compliance and Security Features
product.description: Security and compliance infrastructure including VPC deployment, role-based access, SSO/SAML, and certifications like SOC-2, GDPR, and HIPAA.
